description: Election Commission - Declare that R. A. N. P. Rupasinghe as a Member of the Arranagalla P/S
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Attanagalla Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's death, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of a new elected member, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters and declarations.
